preview_heading: Antigua & Barbuda Falcons vs Jamaica Kingsmen – CPL 2026 Final
preview: Antigua & Barbuda Falcons and Jamaica Kingsmen meet in the CPL 2026 final at Kensington Oval, Barbados, on September 20. The match is scheduled to start at 7:00pm Barbados time, with the tournament title at stake.
preview_detail: Antigua & Barbuda Falcons secured their place in the final by defeating Guyana Amazon Warriors in Qualifier 1 on September 17. Jamaica Kingsmen advanced after beating Barbados Tridents in the Eliminator and Guyana Amazon Warriors in Qualifier 2. The two finalists meet at Kensington Oval to decide the CPL 2026 title.
